_comment: Template for the one-shot-app library: everything the skill learns about its user, so no run asks the same thing twice. The real file lives at ~/.one-shot-app/profile.json (created on first use), never in the skill folder or a repo. Imprint fields are published on each app's website; reviewContact goes to App Review only; nothing else leaves the machine. Secrets belong in ~/.one-shot-app/config.json.

imprint._comment: Impressum (German §5 DDG; §18 MStV for editorial content). Published on every app's /imprint page. The address must be a real postal address for service of documents (no PO box); a c/o imprint service address is fine if it accepts mail. confirmedAt = when the user last confirmed these, re-confirm after 12 months.

reviewContact._comment: App Review contact in App Store Connect. Not published.

accounts._comment: Non-secret account IDs reused across apps, so attended steps get shorter every run.

menuDefaults._comment: The answers from the last run's menu. The next run marks these options '(Same as last time)', so a repeat run is a few clicks.

preferences._comment: Taste and standing instructions the user gave during runs, one short line each, with the date. Read before every run; add to it in phase 11 whenever the user corrected something.

apps._comment: Every app shipped with this skill: for duplicate-app checks (4.3), name collisions and reuse.
